title: JELLY SUB
oneLiner: Pilot a tiny submarine through swaying jellyfish gates without getting stung.
mechanics: Tap A to boost the submarine upward; release to dive.
Thread through gaps between jellyfish to score.
Jellyfish tentacles and the screen edges cost a life.
Gates arrive faster and sway more as your score rises.

controls.b: Toggle sonar pulse for a brief visibility flash

lose: The submarine loses when it touches a jellyfish, tentacle, or screen edge.
scoring: Score one point for each jellyfish gate passed.
